name: BN4's tournament presentation
now: The bracket screen (BN4's main mode 0x24) moved into BN6 as its main mode 0x3C by a recipe of numbers (tools/xrecipe_bracket.py writing src/emu/xbracket_bn4.c; src/emu/xbracket.c installs it where BN4's ROM is read): its code, data and art copied from the player's ROM, 28 calls to BN6's routines of the same body, the music's start audited, the HBlank DMA set through a shim, BN4's menu sprite and BG preset sets moved with it, its 11 eToolkit +0x3C reads shimmed, its RAM in RAM_BRACKET (where BN6's shop decompresses while the map waits). Entered from the map by xbracket_open (BN6's own way out of the map for its shop, then BN4_MAP_LEAVE's calls by their twins, then BN4's set-up) and the dev step `bracket`. Proved by tools/xbracket.py against BN4's own screen in romlab from the same entrants: the four tournaments and a settled round PASS pixel for pixel over 238 frames (one allowed: the first frame's backdrop, the map each opened from); the comparator's mutations (palette, plate, late) and the move's (tournaments) FAIL. Faces for BN6's and BN5's Navis built into it (src/emu/xbracket_faces.c): at install each of the 22 made from the player's ROMs by tools/bn4_faces.py's conversion in C, written into two copies of BN4's plate sheets in FREE_BRACKET_FACES, the moved copy's plate tables grown (frames, palettes, sheets to 0x40; BN4_PLATE_SPRITES and BN4_MENU_SPRITE_PTRS an entry a sheet) through their five literals, so XBR_PLATE_NAVI(n) = 0x20 + the run's navi number draws Navi n; tools/bn4_faces.py check reads the installed plates back as the bracket reads them: 22 of 22 the same byte for byte as the oracle's, its mutation (facepal) FAILs, and the five cases still PASS. Earlier: the screen located and driven in romlab, its RAM, the four tournaments, the cutscene and text commands that open it, no versus screen found (docs/multirom/bn4-tournament.md).
left: Not in a run yet: the tournament's design calls xbracket_open; the return to the map after the screen written as BN6's screens return but not run past the fade; the song not listened to; a script's wait and return (the host's stub); the Free Tournament's own list and its menu sprite types 0x3C and 0x3D stubbed; why BN4's HBlank DMA shows the frame before's values (reproduced by a copy at the mode's start, not read in BN4's handler). Plates 0x01-0x02, 0x05-0x08, 0x0A-0x10 and 0x14-0x15 unnamed; the stage's cutscenes undecoded; main modes 0x10, 0x28, 0x2C and 0x3C of BN4's unidentified. What chooses a plate's lighter variant (1) not found; the head windows and ElecMan's halving chosen by eye.
